note: The signer uses randomized ECDSA. Full APK hashes differ; every physical byte outside the signing block and every ZIP entry must match. Timings are a workstation snapshot, not a performance guarantee. Browser SDK timings exclude JVM initialization; browser memory is WASM linear memory only. No Android device execution was performed.

additional_chromium145_validation.selection: Loop video and its transitive dependencies

previous_measurements.note: These earlier matrix measurements used a different Chromium version. The separate Telegram comparison uses the same Chrome 145 executable and cached profile.

telegram_speed_comparison.method: Sequential single runs on the same workstation, Chrome executable, cached browser profile, input, signed bundle, recommended selection and signing identity. Bridge profiling disabled. No concurrent builds.
